name: inverse leg curl (bench support)
description: Lying or kneeling with your feet anchored on a bench, you bend the knees and bring your body upright. It strongly works the hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel on the pad with your ankles locked under the support behind you.
Keep your body straight from knees to head, arms crossed or in front.
Lean forward slowly, letting your hamstrings control the descent.
Go as low as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to kneeling with your hamstrings.
